909666a3.text: The cult hit us by surprise. Raani never saw it coming and Arvensus took a sword to the gut. For my part, I took a lightning bolt to the chest and blacked out. They never bothered to finish me off... I guess they assumed my wounds would do me in. When it's all said and done, I suspect they might.
909666a3.title: Bloody Note

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251523|191d4b60.name: Constable Aonda
251523|191d4b60.text:
More than I'd like, I'm afraid. We've been harassed by a group of bandits camping out in a cave to the north, and the Al'Aketh cult recently took over Falaath Village to the south of us. I trust every peacekeeper and citizen here, but we are far too few to keep the village secure. 

If the cult decides to continue their expansion here, there's little we can do to stop them.

251903|1b6c392b.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|1b6c392b.text:
I have nothing personally against members of the Windshapers such as yourself, but I also do not need to engage in conversation with you, either. Be about your business, but I'd strongly advise that you give the High Order and our agents a wide berth in your travels through Zephras Isle.

The High Order does not seek conflict... but we will decisively end it, should conflict find us. Stay out of our way, Windshaper.

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

252155|82bfc17b.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
252155|82bfc17b.text: <The corpse lying before you is covered in scorches and burn marks. He seems to be clutching something in his hand.>

254086|e154a23f.name: Shenaan Spellwind
254086|e154a23f.text: The followers of the old Highborne ways have never been more hungry to gain knowledge and reclaim what we've lost. If you would seek to wield the power of the arcane and have the aptitude, I can help you take your next steps.

254100|609c70df.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|609c70df.text: The Windshapers and the High Order are up to something. There are rumors floating around that both groups plan to get the skycutters running again and use them to leave the Skywall. LEAVE SKYWALL? How ridiculous. Where would they even go?

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

257022|5c2244b7.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?
